Hair is made almost entirely of **keratin** , a structural protein. Eating enough dietary protein gives your body the amino acids it needs to build strong hair strands and support the follicle growth cycle.[[1]](https://www.hims.com/blog/protein-for-hair-growth)[[2]](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8647708/)[[3]](https://www.everydayhealth.com/hair-scalp-care/how-much-protein-to-prevent-hair-loss/)

### Top Protein-Rich Foods for Hair Growth

- **Eggs:** Packed with complete, bioavailable protein, eggs also supply **biotin** (a B-vitamin essential for keratin production) and vitamin D.[[1]](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/food-for-hair-growth)[[2]](https://www.womansworld.com/wellness/the-best-protein-rich-food-for-hair-growth-after-50)
- **Fatty Fish (Salmon, Mackerel, Sardines):** Deliver high-quality protein alongside **omega-3 fatty acids** and vitamin D, which reduce inflammation and support scalp and follicle health.[[1]](https://www.healthline.com/nutrition/foods-for-hair-growth)[[2]](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/food-for-hair-growth)
- **Greek Yogurt & Cottage Cheese:** Rich in protein (including casein and whey) as well as vitamin B5 (pantothenic acid), which aids in blood flow to the scalp.[[1]](https://tk-hair.com/best-food-with-protein-for-healthy-hair-growth/)[[2]](https://www.webmd.com/beauty/ss/slideshow-foods-healthy-hair)
- **Poultry (Chicken & Turkey):** Provide lean, high-quality protein and amino acids like L-lysine, which help with iron absorption and tissue repair.[[1]](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/life-style/health-fitness/diet/simple-proteins-that-can-help-in-faster-hair-growth/photostory/124028480.cms)[[2]](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/food-for-hair-growth)
- **Legumes (Lentils, Chickpeas, Beans):** Great plant-based protein options that also deliver iron, zinc, and folate to help oxygenate hair follicles.[[1]](https://www.healthline.com/nutrition/foods-for-hair-growth)[[2]](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/life-style/health-fitness/diet/simple-proteins-that-can-help-in-faster-hair-growth/photostory/124028480.cms)
- **Tofu, Tempeh, & Soy:** Contain complete plant proteins and beneficial compounds like spermidine, which has been linked to the hair growth phase.[[1]](https://www.healthline.com/nutrition/foods-for-hair-growth)
- **Nuts & Seeds (Almonds, Walnuts, Pumpkin Seeds, Flaxseeds):** Offer a mix of plant protein, zinc, selenium, vitamin E, and essential fatty acids to protect against oxidative stress.[[1]](https://www.healthline.com/nutrition/foods-for-hair-growth)[[2]](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/food-for-hair-growth)[[3]](https://tk-hair.com/best-food-with-protein-for-healthy-hair-growth/)

For more details on building a hair-friendly plate, check out the guides from [Healthline](https://www.healthline.com/nutrition/foods-for-hair-growth) and the [Cleveland Clinic](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/food-for-hair-growth).[[1]](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/food-for-hair-growth)[[2]](https://www.healthline.com/nutrition/foods-for-hair-growth)If you'd like, let me know:
